title: OpenRTB 2.6 Deal
description: A specific deal struck between a buyer and a seller.

id.description: A unique identifier for the direct deal.

bidfloor.description: Minimum bid for this impression expressed in CPM.

bidfloorcur.description: Currency specified using ISO-4217 alpha codes.

at.description: Optional override of the overall auction type. 1 = First Price, 2 = Second Price Plus, 3 = agreed upon deal price.

wseat.description: Allowed list of buyer seats allowed to bid on this deal.

wadomain.description: Array of advertiser domains allowed to bid on this deal.

guar.description: Indicates that the deal is guaranteed. 0 = not guaranteed, 1 = guaranteed.

mincpmpersec.description: Minimum CPM per second for video or audio impression opportunities.

durfloors.description: Container for floor price by duration information.

ext.description: Placeholder for exchange-specific extensions to OpenRTB.
